r: This position is created to support the AGORA ERP implementation within Gas Services Distributed in Oman, with a strategic plan to transition the resource into a permanent Commercial Project Manager (CPM) vacancy to retain critical system and business knowledge. Operating within the Gas Services Distributed Finance CPM organization, the role initially will focus on ERP system deployment then will transition to commercial execution in all service lines; long-term service contracts, M&U, Repairs, complex Spare Parts deliveries, Field Services. To address this dual-phase objective, the role focuses on ERP implementation and system optimization, comprehensive financial project management, and risk, contract, and stakeholder management.

These core areas ensure a seamless transition from system setup to high-performing project execution. Given the focus on ERP implementation and project execution, the ideal candidate will have a strong background in finance or business administration, proven experience as a Commercial Project Manager for complex service projects, and deep proficiency in SAP/ERP systems. Professional certification in project management or CPM-C category is highly desirable to support the Gas Services business.

Manage and optimize financial KPIs for actuals, budget, and forecast, including revenue, cost, gross profit, and cash flow. Ensure compliance with Financial Reporting Guidelines (FRG), transfer pricing, tax regulations, and internal controls (LoA, NCM).
Actively performs asset management, initiates invoicing according to project progress and contractual terms. Ensure payment is received on time and allocated properly.

Perform project forecasting, local and WTW reporting, involve offshore CPM organization. Manage project guarantees, bonds and project insurance as well as foreign currency risks in alignment with hedging guidelines
Act as a key user and data steward to support the smooth and successful implementation of AGORA/S4E Unify ERP systems in the Commercial Project Management domain.
Retain and document system knowledge gained during ERP implementation to facilitate a smooth transition into standard CPM operations.

Collaborate with the Project Manager to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and opportunities. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, including customers, subcontractors, and offshore teams, to ensure commercial alignment.

d: Albawani is one of the leading construction and contracting companies in Saudi Arabia. Established in 1991, the company has grown from a small civil works contractor into a major diversified group with operations across construction, infrastructure, engineering, water and power, and industrial services. Headquartered in Riyadh, Albawani is recognised for delivering large-scale commercial, healthcare, educational, and government projects throughout the Kingdom. Albawani is known for its strong commitment to quality, safety, and innovation, holding several international ISO certifications and a Class-1 contractor ranking in Saudi Arabia.

Role Purpose: The Project Manager is responsible for leading, directing, and managing the overall execution and delivery of Al Bawani Construction's project. The role ensures that the project is delivered in accordance with contractual obligations, approved scope, project specifications, quality standards, HSE requirements, approved schedules, budgetary targets, and applicable regulations and security requirements.
